name: Faceless YouTube Video Creation
goal: Create complete YouTube videos without showing your face

steps.name: Research & Scripting
steps.job_to_be_done: Generate engaging video concepts, hook variations, and a complete spoken script formatted with visual cue markers.
inputs: Video topic idea or niche trend
outputs: Scene-by-scene visual descriptions and b-roll cues

steps.name: Voiceover Generation
steps.job_to_be_done: Convert script text into high-fidelity, emotionally nuanced voiceover narration with natural pauses.

steps.name: Video Assembly & Visual B-Roll
steps.job_to_be_done: Generate cinematic b-roll video clips matching visual cues and assemble video sequences aligned to audio pacing.

steps.name: Thumbnail Creation
steps.job_to_be_done: Design a high-CTR YouTube thumbnail using AI subject cutouts, bold typography, and visual hooks.

estimated_cost_per_result.assumptions: Starter profile assumes 10 videos/month using ElevenLabs Starter ($5) + Runway Standard ($12) + Free Scripting (ChatGPT/Claude) + Canva Free ($0). Volume profile assumes batch-rendered short clips utilizing shared plan credits.

commercial_notes: Commercial monetization requires at least ElevenLabs Starter ($5/mo) since the Free tier is strictly non-commercial with mandatory attribution. Runway requires Standard ($12/mo) to remove watermarks. ChatGPT, Claude, and Canva Free tiers allow commercial monetization.

name: YouTube Shorts & TikTok Viral Pipeline
goal: High-volume creation of engaging 30-60s vertical short videos
audience: Shorts creators, TikTokers, Instagram Reels creators

steps.name: Hook & Micro-Scripting
steps.job_to_be_done: Draft 3-second attention-grabbing hooks and 100-word punchy scripts structured for maximum loop retention.

steps.name: High-Energy Voiceover
steps.job_to_be_done: Generate fast-paced, dynamic voice narration with energetic cadence.

steps.name: Automated Video & Captions
steps.job_to_be_done: Auto-match background B-roll footage and generate animated karaoke-style dynamic subtitles.
outputs: 9:16 vertical MP4 video with synced captions

steps.name: Vertical Cover Frame
steps.job_to_be_done: Create a high-contrast thumbnail cover frame to maximize feed click-through rates.

estimated_cost_per_result.assumptions: Starter profile assumes 20 Shorts/mo with ElevenLabs Starter ($5) + Pictory Standard ($19). Volume profile assumes 60 Shorts/mo on bulk plans.

commercial_notes: ElevenLabs Starter ($5/mo) clears commercial rights without attribution. Pictory Standard ($19/mo) provides fully cleared Getty/Storyblocks stock assets for monetized YouTube Shorts.

name: Long-Form Video Essay Pipeline
goal: Produce deep-dive documentary video essays with verified research and cinematic visuals
audience: Video essayists, documentary filmmakers, investigative creators

steps.name: Source-Grounded Research
steps.job_to_be_done: Conduct citation-backed web research and compile verified historical facts and academic sources.
outputs: Detailed research dossier with clickable source citations

steps.name: Narrative Scriptwriting
steps.job_to_be_done: Draft an evocative 2,500-word documentary script with nuanced literary pacing and narrative story arcs.

steps.name: Documentary Voice Narration
steps.job_to_be_done: Synthesize immersive, human-sounding narrative voiceover with authentic breathing intervals.

steps.name: Cinematic B-Roll & Visual Compositing
steps.job_to_be_done: Generate photorealistic scene cutaways and edit audio/video timeline with text-based precision.
outputs: Cinematic B-roll clips and edited rough sequence

steps.name: Cinematic Thumbnail Concept
steps.job_to_be_done: Render a photorealistic, painterly thumbnail visual with dramatic lighting.

estimated_cost_per_result.assumptions: Assumes 4 deep-dive long-form essays per month utilizing Claude Pro ($20) + ElevenLabs Creator ($22) + Midjourney Basic ($8) + Descript Hobbyist ($12).

commercial_notes: All tools on paid tiers provide unencumbered commercial monetization rights. Perplexity citations ensure script compliance with copyright and factual truth standards.

name: Podcast & Audio Storytelling Pipeline
goal: Produce episodic spoken-word audio, multi-speaker podcasts, and audiobooks

steps.name: Episode Outlining & Dialogue Scripting
steps.job_to_be_done: Outline episode talking points and format conversational dialogue between virtual co-hosts.

steps.name: Multi-Speaker Voice Synthesis
steps.job_to_be_done: Generate distinct, realistic character voices with emotional expression and conversational pacing.

steps.name: Studio Audio Mastering & Cleanup
steps.job_to_be_done: Clean background room tone, level speech loudness, and add intro/outro music beds.

steps.name: Podcast Cover Art
steps.job_to_be_done: Design standard 3000x3000px Spotify & Apple Podcasts album artwork.

estimated_cost_per_result.assumptions: Assumes 4 weekly podcast episodes per month using Descript Hobbyist ($12) + ElevenLabs Starter ($5) + free Canva art.

commercial_notes: ElevenLabs and Play.ht commercial licenses cover Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and YouTube Music ad monetization. Descript Studio Sound eliminates expensive physical studio hardware.

name: Long-to-Short Content Repurposing Pipeline
goal: Transform long-form recordings into viral social clips, threads, and summaries
audience: YouTubers with existing libraries, stream clippers, agencies

steps.name: Transcription & Viral Clip Extraction
steps.job_to_be_done: Auto-transcribe 1-hour footage and identify the top 5 most engaging viral segments.
outputs: Timestamped viral clip selections with text transcripts

steps.name: Short-Form Formatting & Captions
steps.job_to_be_done: Auto-refocus speaker into 9:16 vertical layout and generate animated dynamic captions.

steps.name: Newsletter & Social Thread Adaptation
steps.job_to_be_done: Convert the transcript into an engaging written newsletter summary and Twitter/X thread.

steps.name: Social Hook Thumbnail
steps.job_to_be_done: Design branded cover cards for Instagram Reels and LinkedIn carousels.

estimated_cost_per_result.assumptions: Assumes converting 4 long videos into 20 social clips per month using Descript Hobbyist ($12) + Copy.ai Free/Starter.

commercial_notes: Descript Hobbyist ($12/mo) removes all watermarks and exports in full 1080p for client and social monetization.
